signals.usability_note: Clear view of a single-story ranch house frontage across a lawn, though partially screened by a large tree and shrubs in the foreground.

professional_landscaping.detail: Fresh red mulch rings around trees and beds and trimmed round shrubs are visible, but this is consistent with homeowner upkeep; no crew or equipment is present.
